purpose: Govern images, maps, manuscript scans, artifact/site photography, and explanatory diagrams without confusing visual material with evidence.
principles: A visual asset is not evidence merely because it depicts a research entity.
Every displayed research asset must preserve its source page, creator when known, license, rights status, caption, and entity linkage.
Generated or reconstructed imagery must be visibly labeled and may never masquerade as archaeological, historical, ethnographic, manuscript, or museum evidence.
Community-restricted or sacred visual material must follow the strictest applicable access rule.
Remote media URLs are references; provenance belongs to the source page and rights metadata, not to the hotlink.
A primary image is a UI choice, not an epistemic ranking.

preferred_sources.rule: Prefer collection pages with stable catalog identifiers and explicit rights statements.
Use the file description page as source_page_url and preserve creator/license metadata.
Display only when reuse rights are explicit.
Allowed only with GENERATED/RECONSTRUCTION labeling and never as source evidence.

display_gate.rule: Only rights_status=APPROVED may render in the public research UI unless a restricted authenticated surface exists.

evidence_gate.rule: Media can illustrate a source or object; evidentiary claims still require claim/source provenance and an inference level.
